author: crbike
quote:
I can't believe what they did to this game franchise... The only one that stayed true to it's core is gone now and I'm sad and desperate to get in gaming anytime soon...
Story is boring and Jason is character without soul, the same for the other ones... I was so desperate when playing this that I just wanted to play GTA V to cheer me up a little bit.

What also needs to be said is that game mechanic are wonderful and I'm astonished when discovering open world and interact with NPCs, checking places etc...

But story wise this is complete garbage and not worth of GTA title... 

sad
